### Offerpad to Release Third Quarter Results on November 2nd


October 8, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s28.q4cdn.com/618391886/files/doc_news/Offerpad-to-Release-Third-Quarter-Results-on-November-2nd-2026.pdf)


TEMPE, Ariz.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Offerpad Solutions Inc. (“Offerpad”) (Nasdaq: OPAD)](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.offerpad.com%2F&esheet=54617292&newsitemid=20261008092982&lan=en-US&anchor=Offerpad+Solutions+Inc.+%28%22Offerpad%22%29+%28Nasdaq%3A+OPAD%29&index=1&md5=a5b02917f4d6ad5fb8153b8adaf40bc9) , a leading tech-enabled real estate solutions company, announced today that it will release third-quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, November 2, 2026.


The company also will host a conference call at 4:30 p.m. EST / 2:30 p.m. MST that same day to discuss financial results and recent developments. Investors and other interested parties are encouraged to submit questions in advance toinvestors@offerpad.com .


The conference call will be webcast live on the events page of Offerpad’s[Investor Relations website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.offerpad.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54617292&newsitemid=20261008092982&lan=en-US&anchor=Investor+Relations+website&index=2&md5=02cddafbb1f546b9e957e92ef96cba54) . Those interested in the call can also register[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F908419299&esheet=54617292&newsitemid=20261008092982&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=3&md5=b424ef0b8ffaa5c8124ef47061bea886) . A replay of the event will be available on Offerpad’s Investor Relations website after the live webcast concludes.


**About Offerpad**


Offerpad Solutions Inc. (Nasdaq: OPAD) is a real estate solutions company focused on giving homeowners more control, flexibility, and choice when buying and selling a home. The Company provides Cash Offers, Brokerage Services, access to additional cash buyers through marketplace-enabled capabilities, and renovation services that support both internal transactions and third-party partners.


Founded in 2015, the Company combines proprietary technology with local real estate expertise to simplify the home sale process and reduce friction across the transaction lifecycle, helping customers move forward with speed, transparency, and confidence. Learn more at[www.offerpad.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.offerpad.com%2F&esheet=54617292&newsitemid=20261008092982&lan=en-US&anchor=www.offerpad.com&index=4&md5=75db2f045a00dcc27b66846b84c8311a) .
